clauses.reason: The order exempts Edward P. Davis, topographic engineer, Geological Survey, Department of the Interior, from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, and fixes the period in its own words: "for a period of one year ending June 30, 1942". The end is recorded as June 30, 1942 (1942-06-30), inclusive: the exemption runs through that day. The exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is the alternative. MOMMSEN-I recheck: GPO OCR retirment / APP retirement, an obvious spelling error with no changed command.
